scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter ./artifacts/parts-id run test && pnpm --filter ./artifacts/api-server run test && pnpm --filter ./lib/api-client-react run test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter ./artifacts/parts-id run test && pnpm --filter ./artifacts/api-server run test:unit && pnpm --filter ./lib/api-client-react run test

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '^lib/api-spec/openapi\.yaml|^lib/api-client-react/src/generated/|^lib/api-zod/src/generated/'; then pnpm codegen:check; fi
